description.narrative: The most significant expected project-level outcomes are (i) stakeholder effects, where the Project aims to fulfil the demand for recycled PET; (ii) economywide effects, where the Project seeks to create value through a circular economy of PET waste and create employment; and (iii) environmental effects, where the Project diverts plastic waste away from environment and channels them to recycling processes. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates the potential to encourage more PET bottle producers to establish recycling operations.

The proposed investment is for an IFC A loan of up to US$250 million to Indorama Ventures Global Services Limited (IVGS or the Company). In 2020, IFC had provided a US$300 million loan package consisting of a US$150 million IFC A loan and parallel loans of US$150 million from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and Deutsche Investitions- und Entwicklungsgesellschaft (DEG) to IVGS (Board reference no. IFC/R2014-0206). IVGS, incorporated in Thailand is a subsidiary of Indorama Ventures Public Company Limited (IVL or the Group), is one of the worlds leading intermediate petrochemicals producers, with a global manufacturing footprint across Africa, Asia Pacific, Europe and Americas. The Companys product portfolio is classified into 3 segments: Combined PET (CPET), Integrated Oxides & Derivatives (IOD) and Fibers.
